---
title: "Nonprofit Density: Data and Multiverse"
subtitle: "Replication files, data workflow and multiverse analysis"
author: "Jesse Lecy and Jeremy P. Thornton"
---

This site documents the database behind our study of nonprofit density in US counties
and metropolitan areas, 2000–2024, and the multiverse analysis built on it. It covers
how the data are assembled, every input file and its source, the code that rebuilds the
database from frozen inputs, and the design, execution and results of the multiverse.

| Part | What it covers |
|---|---|
| [1. Dataset construction](site/01-construction.qmd) | Units, build stages, final tables, key measurement choices |
| [2. Files, sources and dictionaries](site/02-files-sources.qmd) | Every data source with citation and licence, the frozen-file manifest, variable dictionaries |
| [3. Workflow code](site/03-workflow.qmd) | Restoring inputs, running the build step by step, checking the result |
| [4. Multiverse overview](paper/03-multiverse-overview.qmd) | Why a multiverse, the specification grid, attributing spread to decisions |
| [5. Multiverse design](paper/04-design-decisions.qmd) | Decision cards D1–D12; [variables and constructs](paper/02-variables.qmd) |
| [6. Stylized facts](paper/01-stylized-facts.qmd) | Seven regularities in density data |
| [7. Running the multiverse](site/07-multiverse-run.qmd) | Code, execution and [findings](paper/05-findings.qmd) |
| [8. Where the research goes](site/08-next.qmd) | Open gaps and next steps |

Code: [github.com/lecy/multiverse](https://github.com/lecy/multiverse).
Frozen inputs: `s3://lecy/nonprofit-density/inputs/`.
